articles.summary: The Incline Village General Improvement District (IVGID) Effluent Export Pipeline project, located in Washoe County, Nevada, has received a John L. Martin Partnering Project of the Year Award from the International Partnering Institute (IPI). The award recognizes project teams that demonstrate a strong commitment to collaboration, trust, and shared success.
articles.title: Granite’s IVGID Pipeline Project Recognized for Excellence in Partnering and Collaboration

articles.summary: WATSONVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Granite (NYSE:GVA) announced today that it has been awarded the All American Boulevard Construction and Kennedy Boulevard Widening project by Orange County, Florida
articles.title: Granite Awarded $41 Million Project in Orange County, Florida
